newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates newspapers - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates newspapers - March 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The contest to land the UAE's biggest-ever arms contract was thrown wide open again on Monday with fresh French and British offers to supply up to 80 multi-role fighter aircraft.
- Emirates Airlines formally signed a $500 million contract with Rolls Royce announced earlier this year for the purchase of 37 Trent 700 engines.
- Preparations are underway by the Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Company to set up a $125 million dock in Al Taweelah.
- The Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait opened a representative office in Dubai on Monday.
- The UAE's Al-Dhafra Insurance company reported net profits of 23.8 million dirhams in 1996 up from 22.9 million in 1995.
